english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for describing doing something in this way or manner.

english.meaning: so, likewise; in the same way
english.note: Use this for doing or being something in the same way as what was just mentioned.

examples.english: If you do it thus, it’ll be right.
examples.jyutping: nei5 gam2 joeng6 zou6 zau6 ngaam1 laa3

examples.english: Do it so, just the way I told you, and you won’t go wrong.
examples.traditional: 你照住我講噉樣做，就唔會錯。
examples.jyutping: nei5 ziu3 zyu6 ngo5 gong2 gam2 joeng6 zou6 zau6 m4 wui5 co3
